implemented_modes.title: Monthly + annual contributions
implemented_modes.formula: Ending balance = opening growth + each contribution grown from its event time − modeled interest tax.

implemented_modes.scope: This simplified model assumes distribution factors 0.68 (male) and 0.55 (female). Absorption and elimination differ substantially between people.

jurisdiction: not established; review formulas and assumptions

formula_references.title: Schneider Electric: voltage drop in steady load conditions
2017 NEC, Chapter 9 Table 9, page 70–690 (Nye County reference copy)

implemented_modes.title: DC two-wire circuit
implemented_modes.formula: Loop resistance = 2×resistivity×one-way length/area; voltage drop = current×loop resistance.
implemented_modes.scope: Uses nominal 20°C resistivity and linear temperature correction. This is a simplified DC estimate, not an NEC ampacity or AC impedance lookup.

implemented_modes.title: Entered resistance or AC impedance
implemented_modes.formula: Drop = k × current × one-way length × longitudinal coefficient / parallel conductors.
implemented_modes.scope: k=2 for DC/single phase and √3 for balanced three phase. With R/X, coefficient = R×PF ± X×sqrt(1−PF²). Entered effective coefficients are used directly; this is a small-drop approximation.

implemented_modes.title: Wire gauge, area & nominal resistance
implemented_modes.formula: AWG diameter(mm)=0.127×92^((36−gauge)/39). DC loop resistance=2×resistivity×length/area.
implemented_modes.scope: Equivalent solid geometry is separate from insulated cable diameter. Nominal silver/gold/copper/aluminum constants are not manufacturer cable tables, NEC impedance values or ampacity ratings.

implemented_modes.title: 2017 NEC impedance reference
implemented_modes.formula: Line-to-line drop (V) = √3 × current(A) × length(ft) / 1000 × [R × PF + X × √(1 − PF²)].
implemented_modes.scope: Uses the numerical resistance and reactance relationships from 2017 NEC Chapter 9 Table 9. The lookup assumes 75 °C conductors, 60 Hz, three single UL RHH Class B stranded conductors in a cradled arrangement, up to 600 V. Length is converted to the table’s 1000-foot basis. This dated reference does not establish current local code compliance.
